answer_1.quote: We provide experimentation on two datasets, scholarly articles and diary‑style entries ... JAMDEC generates obfuscated text preserving content while altering style.

answer_2.quote: We use five automatic evaluations; Drop Rate (ENS and BertAA), METEOR, NLI, and CoLA.

answer_3.quote: We use a NLI model WANLI to predict entailment between original and obfuscated text, and a CoLA model to assess grammatical acceptability.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluations were conducted on AMT‑3 using Amazon Mechanical Turk workers who rated five questions on a three‑point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Workers read original and obfuscated passages and answered five Likert‑scale questions.
